title: bug: hot reload has a check-to-exec race after verifying committed wrapper bytes
description:
Adversarial review of 5998f871: both wrappers verify git diff, then parse/deregister/reload the mutable pathname. A write after the successful diff can therefore be loaded without being committed.
Scratch /mnt/d/moe-scratch/r-5998f871/probe-race.sh uses the real sh gate and a git shim that runs real diff then appends before returning rc0: gate returns RELOAD while immediate real git diff HEAD returns 1. Investigate a pinned-byte reload design; current approved plan explicitly preserves parse/handover bodies.

implementationPlan.description:
TEST FIRST, sh twin + shared knob (RED before any wrapper edit).
(a) scripts/tests/postflight-fake-proxy.js, `case 'deregister_worker'`: add knob FAKE_RELOAD_RACE_SRC / FAKE_RELOAD_RACE_DST, documented at the handler like the other FAKE_* knobs. When `args.reason === 'wrapper_restart'` and SRC exists, BEFORE ok(): `fs.writeFileSync(DST, fs.readFileSync(SRC))` (rewrites the existing wrapper in place, no rename), then `fs.unlinkSync(SRC)` (one-shot). The deregister is synchronous in both wrappers, so this write lands after the committed check and the parse but before the hand-over loads bytes. That is the check-to-exec window, independent of which git commands the fix runs.
Error handling: let an fs error throw. The arm asserts SRC was consumed, so a swallowed deregister failure cannot pass vacuously.
(b) scripts/tests/postflight.sh: new arm `[hot reload race] a write after the committed check is never loaded`.
- Placement: after the deferred/unverifiable loop, before [stale offset].
- Reuse RELOAD_DIR/RELOAD_PROJECT/RELOAD_WRAPPER and reload_repo/reload_commit/reload_wait/reload_seq/reload_fail.
- Setup is the same as the deferred arm, plus a private RACE_TMP=$RELOAD_DIR/tmp.
- Before launch, a node one-liner prepares two contents. Edit A = original + '# race A\n'. $RELOAD_DIR/race.src = edit A with the single 'Agent idle, checking for tasks in' replaced by 'MOE_TEST_RACE_LOADED from ${BASH_SOURCE[0]}, checking for tasks in'. Exit non-zero unless exactly one occurrence.
- Launch like [hot reload], adding TMPDIR=$RACE_TMP FAKE_RELOAD_RACE_SRC=$RELOAD_DIR/race.src FAKE_RELOAD_RACE_DST=$RELOAD_WRAPPER (FAKE_CLAIM_MODE=idle MOE_DISABLE_HEARTBEAT=1 --loop --poll-interval 1).

Phase A:
- Write edit A, reload_commit 'race A', reload_wait 1 '^c+rc{3,}$'.
- Fail unless race.src is gone, the wrapper contains MOE_TEST_RACE_LOADED, and `reload_git diff --quiet -- moe-agent.sh` exits 1.
- reload_fail 'the restart loaded bytes written after the committed check' if the seat output contains MOE_TEST_RACE_LOADED.

Phase B:
- reload_commit 'race write', reload_wait 2 '^c+rc+rc{3,}$'.
- Require an output line matching 'MOE_TEST_RACE_LOADED from .*/moe-wrapper-pin\.[^/]+/moe-agent\.sh,' (committed bytes load, from a private copy).

Phase C:
- node renames every MOE_WRAPPER_SOURCE to MOE_WRAPPER_ORIGIN in the wrapper (fail if none).
- reload_commit 'drop hand-over', reload_wait 3 '^c+rc+rc+rc{3,}$'.
- Require grep -F "MOE_TEST_RACE_LOADED from $RELOAD_WRAPPER," (bytes without the hand-over reload from the checkout path).
- Require that no moe-wrapper-pin.* entry is left in RACE_TMP.

Kill the seat and restore LIVE_PIDS as the sibling arms do, then print '[hot reload race] ok: ...'.

implementationPlan.description:
sh runtime, scripts/moe-agent.sh: pinned reload.

(1) Top, replacing the SCRIPT_DIR line:
- MOE_WRAPPER_FILE=${BASH_SOURCE[0]:-$0}.
- ONLY when that path lies in a */moe-wrapper-pin.*/ folder, use ${MOE_WRAPPER_SOURCE:-...} (the checkout path a hot reload hands over).
- ALWAYS `unset MOE_WRAPPER_SOURCE`, so no child ever inherits it.
- SCRIPT_DIR from dirname of MOE_WRAPPER_FILE.

(2) At the reload block:
- MOE_WRAPPER_PATH="$SCRIPT_DIR/${MOE_WRAPPER_FILE##*/}" (absolute).
- MOE_WRAPPER_LAUNCH_HASH = sha256 of the file this process actually loaded (${BASH_SOURCE[0]:-$0}, the copy when pinned). A write after the hand-over can never become the launch hash, and launch == live for a clean checkout, so there is no thrash.
- Then, only when that loaded file differs from MOE_WRAPPER_PATH: best-effort `rm -f` of it and `rmdir` of its folder. Bash holds the script open, and the {...exit} group reads on from that descriptor (prototyped).

(3) wrapper_reload_deferred keeps the 5998f871 ls-files/diff gate and its messages unchanged. When diff is clean it pins:
- mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/moe-wrapper-pin.XXXXXX" (0700); cp the wrapper into it under the same leaf.
- Require `git -C "$SCRIPT_DIR" hash-object --path=<leaf> -- <copy>` to equal `git -C "$SCRIPT_DIR" rev-parse --verify -q HEAD:./<leaf>`. These are the same clean filters diff uses; verified on git 2.43 with a CRLF copy.
- On success, return 1 with MOE_WRAPPER_PIN=<copy>. MOE_WRAPPER_PIN is reset at the top of every call.
- A blob mismatch (a write between diff and cp) defers with the rc-1 'uncommitted edits' message.
- A failed mktemp/cp defers with 'cannot confirm the wrapper bytes are committed (private copy failed)'.
- A rev-parse/hash-object failure defers with '(git rev-parse|hash-object exited N)'.
- A copy that lacks the string MOE_WRAPPER_SOURCE (bytes that predate or revert this hand-over, and would resolve helpers beside the copy) is dropped. The call returns 1 with MOE_WRAPPER_PIN empty, which means a legacy reload of the checkout path.

(4) Reload branch:
- `bash -n "${MOE_WRAPPER_PIN:-$MOE_WRAPPER_PATH}"`.
- One helper drops the pin. It removes only a moe-wrapper-pin.* folder and clears the variable. Call it on parse refusal (the refused hash is the parsed bytes' hash) and on the MOE_HEARTBEAT_STOP_TIMEOUT continue.
- After deregister and the SECURE_TEMP_DIR removal, when pinned: `MOE_WRAPPER_SOURCE="$MOE_WRAPPER_PATH" exec "$BASH" "$MOE_WRAPPER_PIN" "${MOE_WRAPPER_ARGV[@]}"`. Otherwise `exec "$BASH" "$MOE_WRAPPER_PATH" ...`. Keep the failure echo.
- cleanup_temp drops a staged pin (type -t guard, like its siblings).

Error handling: every new command uses the `|| rc=$?` pattern, so set -e can never end the seat inside the check. Every failure defers and keeps serving the current bytes. Announcement, deregister reason and stop/deregister order stay byte-identical.
implementationPlan.note:
The pinned reload is in place in scripts/moe-agent.sh (+74/-15; `bash -n` OK).

What it does:
- Top of file: `MOE_WRAPPER_FILE` is read; MOE_WRAPPER_SOURCE is honoured only when the running file is inside `*/moe-wrapper-pin.*/*`; MOE_WRAPPER_SOURCE is then always unset; SCRIPT_DIR is derived from MOE_WRAPPER_FILE. The WT-13 refusal message also names MOE_WRAPPER_FILE.
- `MOE_WRAPPER_PATH` is now absolute: `$SCRIPT_DIR/<leaf>`.
- The launch hash is taken from BASH_SOURCE, i.e. the bytes actually loaded.
- `wrapper_reload_deferred` keeps the ls-files/diff gate and its messages unchanged, then pins:
  - mktemp -d, then cp the wrapper into that folder;
  - `git hash-object --path=<leaf>` of the copy must equal `rev-parse --verify -q HEAD:./<leaf>`;
  - on a mismatch it defers with "uncommitted edits"; on a copy or git failure it defers with `(private copy failed)` / `(git rev-parse|hash-object exited N)`;
  - if the copy lacks MOE_WRAPPER_SOURCE, the pin is dropped and the reload is the legacy one from the checkout path.
- `bash -n` checks the copy.
- The pin is dropped on parse refusal, on the HEARTBEAT_STOP_TIMEOUT continue, and in cleanup_temp (type -t guard).
- Hand-over: `MOE_WRAPPER_SOURCE=$MOE_WRAPPER_PATH exec "$BASH" <copy>`; without a pin, `exec "$BASH" <checkout>`.

Deviations from the plan:
1. The self-delete runs only when `BASH_SOURCE != MOE_WRAPPER_FILE`, i.e. a handed-over copy, and `wrapper_pin_drop` also checks the folder name. Comparing with MOE_WRAPPER_PATH instead would misfire on a relative-path launch.
2. `wrapper_pin_stage` was split out of `wrapper_reload_deferred` to keep each function short.
3. On refusal, the `bash -n` error names the copy, so the copy path is replaced with the checkout path. Adversarial review in this session found that bash 5.2's patsub_replacement turned an `&` in the checkout path into the matched text. The replacement is now quoted, and the fix was checked on the exact production line with the path `R&D $x`.

All new commands use `|| rc=$?`, so set -e cannot end the seat inside the check.

- Reload-only scratch GREEN: /tmp/green-69c02444.hhMvuI.run2 exited 0. All six reload arms passed, plus [stale offset]; the race sequence was crcccrcccrccc.
- Mutant with the self-delete removed: /tmp/mut-69c02444.BYRoLM.run2 exited 1 with "the running copy did not delete itself once loaded".

implementationPlan.description:
ps1 runtime, scripts/moe-agent.ps1: pinned reload (prototyped on PS 5.1).

(1) Supervisor at the top:
- $global:MoeWrapperSourcePath = $PSCommandPath for the loop's life.
- Reset $global:MoeWrapperReload and $global:MoeWrapperReloadPin before each pass.
- Run $global:MoeWrapperReloadPin when the previous pass set it, else $PSCommandPath.
- Once a pass that ran a copy returns, remove the copy's folder. Only a moe-wrapper-pin.* leaf; -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; capture $LASTEXITCODE first.
- The finally clears $global:MoeWrapperSourcePath and removes a staged copy no pass ran.
- The catch/throw and the 'wrapper relaunch failed' text stay.

(2) Directly after the supervisor block:
- $script:MoeWrapperPath = $global:MoeWrapperSourcePath if set, else $PSCommandPath.
- $script:MoeScriptRoot = Split-Path -Parent of it, else $PSScriptRoot.
- Replace every other $PSScriptRoot with $script:MoeScriptRoot: proxy root, daemon root, $pluginRoot, prompt-cache.mjs, moe-account-lease.mjs, both mods dirs, plus any a peer added meanwhile.
- Delete the later `$script:MoeWrapperPath = $PSCommandPath` line.

(3) Launch hash from [IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($PSCommandPath): the bytes this pass loaded.

(4) Test-MoeWrapperReloadDeferred keeps its ls-files/diff gate and messages. When diff is clean:
- If $global:MoeWrapperSourcePath is unset (a pre-fix supervisor reruns the checkout path), return $false with no copy.
- Else read the wrapper bytes once and [IO.File]::WriteAllBytes them to <[IO.Path]::GetTempPath()>/moe-wrapper-pin.<guid N>/<leaf>.
- Require Invoke-MoeGit `rev-parse --verify -q HEAD:./<leaf>` and `hash-object --path=<leaf> -- <copy>` to both return Rc 0 and the same id. Then set $script:MoeWrapperPin and return $false.
- Mismatch, failure and marker rules are the same as the sh twin: no 'MoeWrapperSourcePath' in the copy means a legacy reload with no copy. Reason texts are identical, including 'private copy failed'.

(5) Reload branch:
- ParseFile the copy when set.
- Remove it on refusal and on the MOE_HEARTBEAT_STOP_TIMEOUT continue.
- At the hand-over, set $global:MoeWrapperReloadPin = $script:MoeWrapperPin before `break`, so the supervisor can remove it even if the bottom hand-over is skipped. The bottom `$global:MoeWrapperReload = $true` stays.

Error handling: the copy block runs inside the existing try/catch. Any exception defers with '(private copy failed: <message>)' and never ends or deregisters the seat. Preserve the UTF-8 BOM and LF endings.
implementationPlan.note:
The pinned reload is in place in scripts/moe-agent.ps1 (+99/-27). The file keeps its UTF-8 BOM and LF line endings and parses with 0 errors on PowerShell 5.1 and 7.6.

What changed:
- Supervisor:
  - It sets $global:MoeWrapperSourcePath = $PSCommandPath for the life of the loop.
  - Before each pass it resets Reload/ReloadPin/LASTEXITCODE.
  - It runs $global:MoeWrapperReloadPin when the previous pass staged one, otherwise $PSCommandPath.
  - After each pass, and again in the finally for any staged copy no pass ran, it drops the copy with $moeDropPin. That drop never touches the launched file and only acts on a moe-wrapper-pin.* folder.
  - The catch/throw is unchanged.
- $script:MoeWrapperPath and $script:MoeScriptRoot are resolved right after the supervisor. All 7 $PSScriptRoot uses (proxy root, daemon root, pluginRoot, prompt-cache.mjs, moe-account-lease.mjs, both mods dirs) now use MoeScriptRoot; a grep finds $PSScriptRoot only in the fallback on line 116. The later `$script:MoeWrapperPath = $PSCommandPath` line is gone. The WT-13 guard reads $script:MoeWrapperPath.
- The launch hash is taken from ReadAllBytes($PSCommandPath), i.e. the bytes this pass actually loaded.
- New-MoeWrapperPin:
  - reads the bytes once and writes them to %TEMP%/moe-wrapper-pin.<guid N>/<leaf>;
  - requires Invoke-MoeGit `rev-parse --verify -q HEAD:./<leaf>` and `hash-object --path=<leaf> -- <copy>` to return Rc 0 with the same id;
  - on a mismatch, defers with 'uncommitted edits';
  - on a failure, defers with `(private copy failed[: msg])` or `(git rev-parse|hash-object exited N)`;
  - if the copy lacks 'MoeWrapperSourcePath', does a legacy reload with no copy.
- A pre-fix supervisor (no SourcePath) gets no copy.
- The reload branch runs ParseFile on the copy. The copy is dropped on refusal and on the HEARTBEAT_STOP_TIMEOUT continue, and stays staged through the break for the supervisor.

Deviations from the plan:
1. The pin lives only in $global:MoeWrapperReloadPin; there is no $script:MoeWrapperPin. The supervisor reads the global anyway, which makes the plan's copy-before-break a no-op.
2. Deletes are non-recursive ([IO.File]::Delete then [IO.Directory]::Delete) instead of -Recurse. This avoids PS 5.1 following junctions when it recurses, and matches the sh twin's rm -f + rmdir.
3. Added in review: a pinned pass deletes its own copy just after the launch hash (PowerShell has already parsed the whole file), so a hard-killed seat leaves no copy behind. The supervisor's drop is the fallback.

implementationPlan.description:
Adversarial self-review: one pass over the whole diff, before complete_task.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: (1) Keep loading the checkout path and re-verify inside the new process: rejected. bash reads incrementally and PowerShell has already parsed by then, and there are no last-good bytes to fall back on. (2) Materialize `git cat-file blob HEAD:<path>`: rejected. Raw blob bytes can differ from the checkout under eol conversion, so the launch hash would never match the live hash and the seat would reload every iteration; copying the live bytes and verifying with hash-object --path compares like with like. (3) Race test via a git PATH shim: rejected. It depends on which git commands the fix runs, and .cmd shims are fragile under PowerShell. The fake-proxy deregister hook lands the write after every check in both twins, deterministically. (4) ps1 scriptblock from Parser.ParseInput(text, path): rejected, because `exit` inside a scriptblock ends the supervisor. (5) Copy inside scripts/ or a symlink farm: rejected. planningNotes.codebaseInsights: Both wrappers already funnel every reload through one loop-top branch, after the poll sleep and before dispatch. The deregister is synchronous in both (moe-call.sh / Invoke-MoeRpc via MOE_PROXY_PATH), which makes it a deterministic injection point for the racing write. The ps1 supervisor is launch-time code, so passes must keep it backward compatible: the presence of $global:MoeWrapperSourcePath is the capability signal. scripts/CLAUDE.md's Hot reload bullet documents the gate commands verbatim and must change with them. parity-check lists only the prefix 'cannot confirm the wrapper bytes are committed (', so new reason texts need no list edit as long as both twins match.

- Revert hazard: bytes without the hand-over, run from a copy, would resolve helpers in the temp folder (deregister, landing, prompt cache). The marker fallback and Phase C cover this.
